hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Landing nipples and profiles
function: Short profiled subs in the tubing string where wireline-set plugs, chokes, and safety valves can be locked and sealed.

tabs.overview: Placed at planned depths: below the safety valve, above the packer, at the tail. A lock mandrel run on slickline latches in the profile; a no-go profile stops tools from passing.
tabs.engineering: Profile size stepped so tools reach the intended nipple; pressure rating with the tubing.
tabs.safety: Plugs set in nipples are barriers for tree work.
tabs.evidence: API 6A scope for trees (S1), API Spec 14A for safety valves (S29), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
